items.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health: tenant metadata exposed
items.note: Microsoft confirmed to BleepingComputer that it fixed the security issue and notified affected customers. The number of organizations affected was not disclosed.

items.title: USDA: intrusion into a farm-payment system reported
items.note: NBC News reported that intruders accessed a system used for farmer payments, citing sources familiar with the incident. The scope of any data exposure remains unverified here.

items.title: Chase, Visa and Mastercard: customer data exposed at vendors
items.note: The companies described third-party incidents involving limited customer information. Visa said its systems and card numbers were not affected.

items.title: Uber: driver license data exposed through a service provider
items.note: Uber’s notice describes unauthorized access through a service provider. TechCrunch reported that Uber was notifying close to 150,000 drivers.

items.title: Vanderbilt University: cyberattack disrupted campus IT
items.note: Vanderbilt advised its community to shut down devices and disconnect from campus Wi-Fi while it contained the incident. The university was still investigating what data was accessed.

items.title: Fandango Media LLC
items.note: 1,346 Massachusetts residents reported affected; links to the state report.

items.title: Prism Medical Products, LLC
items.note: 5,899 Massachusetts residents reported affected; links to the state report.
